integrity: Stand-alone proof, source comparisons and executable Python verifier included. Finite checks do not certify infinite theorems.
scientific_limitations: Finite ultrametrics and 1-Lipschitz retractions only; claims concern concrete image subsets. Existing existence and single-partition idempotent results are acknowledged. No closed form for entropy constant asserted. Related inaccessible literature and implicit wreath-product antecedents remain risks.
title: Full-branching rigidity and rank spectra of uniquely retractable finite ultrametrics
